item.title: Murmurly 1.12.1
item.description:
Try it here

The Dictation page now opens with a practice field. Click into it, hold your key, speak, let go — the words land there, cleaned up, exactly as they would in a document, and nothing can go wrong. It stays until you've dictated something for real, then folds away behind a link.

Coming from Murmur 1.10

If you still have Murmur 1.10, download Murmurly from murmurly.prayasmittal.com and drag it to Applications; the updater in 1.10 can't install it. Murmurly 1.11 and later update normally.
